record_title: A boundary-integrability obstruction for singularity-weighted PINN residuals
provenance: Boundary-asymptotic analysis of the strong residual and inverse-solution weighting proposed for the singular elliptic PINN in arXiv:2609.19335v1, with deterministic collocation-scaling verification.
limitations: The theorem concerns each fixed finite smooth hard-constrained trial and its continuum or resolution limit; it does not imply that every finite training run fails. The multidimensional statement assumes a smooth boundary patch and a simple-zero hard factor, and the boundary enrichment cancels only the leading singular term.

artifact_inventory.description: Deterministic evaluation of standard and singularity-weighted strong-residual losses for an exactly source-compatible smooth hard trial on quasi-uniform grids.
Recorded output from the deterministic collocation-resolution verification.
